objective: Deliver Xylem's Note to Jediga in Azshara.

description: What is it? Oh yes, your payment. Of course.
Take this and be off with you. I'm sure Jediga is awaiting oh so patiently for your return.
progress: Well, what did Xylem have to say? He didn't do anything to you, did he? Cast a spell on you? Con you into doing work for him?
completion: No problems? None at all? Well, that's something to be said... I expected him to show some sort of reluctance or to at least betray our deal. Hmm, maybe he can be trusted after all.
Well, no need to dwell on it that much. Here's your share. Thank you for your help.
